mapper.insert: WITH source AS MATERIALIZED ( SELECT d.*, encode(gen_random_bytes(40), 'hex') AS new_dept_key FROM hrm_org_dept d WHERE d.reorg_key = #{sourceReorgKey} AND d.use_yn = 'Y' ) INSERT INTO hrm_org_dept (dept_key, reorg_key, dept_cd, dept_nm, eng_dept_nm, parent_dept_key, dept_level, sort_order, change_type_cd, chef_emp_no, dept_sys_cd, use_yn, remark, reg_user, ai_profile, extra_attributes) SELECT source.new_dept_key, #{targetReorgKey}, source.dept_cd, source.dept_nm, source.eng_dept_nm, parent.new_dept_key, source.dept_level, source.sort_order, source.change_type_cd, source.chef_emp_no, source.dept_sys_cd, 'Y', source.remark, #{regUser}, source.ai_profile, source.extra_attributes FROM source LEFT JOIN source parent ON parent.dept_key = source.parent_dept_key

WITH RECURSIVE descendants AS ( SELECT dept_key FROM hrm_org_dept WHERE reorg_key = #{reorgKey} AND parent_dept_key = #{deptKey} AND use_yn = 'Y' UNION ALL SELECT child.dept_key FROM hrm_org_dept child JOIN descendants parent ON parent.dept_key = child.parent_dept_key WHERE child.reorg_key = #{reorgKey} AND child.use_yn = 'Y' ) UPDATE hrm_org_dept SET dept_level = dept_level + #{levelDelta}, upd_user = #{updUser}, upd_dtm = NOW() WHERE dept_key IN (SELECT dept_key FROM descendants)
